name: Пастки: усунення захисника + SM
description: A defender can also be disabled with the aim of delivering checkmate. In this lesson, we focus on the method of capturing.

examples.text:
Both 1.Nxe6 and 1.fxe6 disable the defender of the checkmate square g7. The disadvantage of 1.fxe6 is that White leaves the knight on d4 unprotected, allowing Black to capture it with check. After 1.fxe6 Bxd4+ 2.Kc1 Bxf6! (with this capture, White can no longer deliver checkmate on g7), Black escapes the trouble.

By moving the knight and simultaneously disabling the defender, White wins material or - in the case of recapture - delivers checkmate: 1.Nxe6! fxe6 2.Qg7#.

The knight on f6 defends against checkmate on h7, so this piece must be disabled.

An awkward move is 1.Nxf6, because after 1...exf6, Black recaptures with a discovered check! This prevents White from capturing on h7.

Therefore, the correct move is 1.Bxf6!. If Black recaptures, it leads to checkmate: 1...exf6 2.Qxh7#.

texts: Choose the right capture. Always ask yourself: what can the opponent do in response?
